answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in canyon, verified in island, and dune names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 5 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 1 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
